import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0,'C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/filing-fetch/scripts')
import transcript_tool_transport as owner
import ff_process_transport as transport


@pytest.mark.parametrize('fault',[None,'source_sha','receipt_identity','receipt_json'])
def test_known_source_actual_byte_budget_and_large_receipt_remain_separate(tmp_path,monkeypatch,fault):
    raw=b'abc'
    sha=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    ref={'document_id':'urn:company-wiki:document:sha256:'+sha,'source_id':'urn:company-wiki:source:sha256:'+sha,
      'content_sha256':sha,'byte_size':3,'mime_type':'text/plain'}
    receipt={'status':'ok',**{k:ref[k] for k in ('document_id','source_id','content_sha256','byte_size')}}
    if fault=='receipt_identity':receipt['source_id']='wrong-source'
    # Construct inside the real child, avoiding Windows command-line payload limits.
    code='import sys,json;r='+repr(receipt)+";r['manifest']={'title':'语'*30000};"
    code+="sys.stdout.buffer.write("+repr(b'abd' if fault=='source_sha' else raw)+");"
    if fault=='receipt_json':code+="sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'not JSON'+b'x'*90000)"
    else:code+="sys.stderr.buffer.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'))"
    seen=[]
    native=transport.run_bounded_json
    def run(command,**kwargs):
        seen.append(kwargs)
        return native([sys.executable,'-B','-c',code],**kwargs)
    monkeypatch.setattr(owner,'_run_bounded_json',run)
    tool=owner.EarningsTranscriptsTransport(wiki_root=tmp_path,deadline=time.monotonic()+6)
    if fault:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):tool._verified_open(ref)
    else:
        observed=tool._verified_open(ref)
        assert observed['manifest']['title']=='语'*30000
    assert len(seen)==1 and seen[0]['stdout_cap_bytes']==3 and seen[0]['stderr_cap_bytes'] is None
    assert tool.company_wiki_calls==1


def test_explicit_stderr_quota_still_stops_during_read_and_reclaims_process(tmp_path):
    marker=tmp_path/'child.pid'
    command=[sys.executable,'-B','-c',
      "import os,sys,time;from pathlib import Path;"+f"Path({str(marker)!r}).write_text(str(os.getpid()));"+
      "sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'x'*1025);sys.stderr.buffer.flush();time.sleep(20)"]
    started=time.monotonic()
    with pytest.raises(transport.OutputLimitExceeded):
        transport.run_bounded_json(command,timeout_seconds=6,stdout_cap_bytes=1024,stderr_cap_bytes=1024)
    assert time.monotonic()-started<5 and marker.exists()
    assert not transport.pid_is_alive(int(marker.read_text()))


def test_stderr_without_representation_cap_keeps_real_deadline(tmp_path):
    marker=tmp_path/'child.pid'
    command=[sys.executable,'-B','-c',
      "import os,sys,time;from pathlib import Path;"+f"Path({str(marker)!r}).write_text(str(os.getpid()));"+
      "sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'x'*90000);sys.stderr.buffer.flush();time.sleep(20)"]
    with pytest.raises(transport.ChildTimeout):
        transport.run_bounded_json(command,timeout_seconds=1,stdout_cap_bytes=3,stderr_cap_bytes=None)
    assert marker.exists() and not transport.pid_is_alive(int(marker.read_text()))
